svg.aria-label: Hi, I'm Asha Jyothi Boddu. I make LLMs explain. Plain code decides. Agents, RAG and evals, shipped live. Research: what AI agents inherit when models swap. Open to AI/ML and SDE internships, 2027. B.Tech CS (AI & ML), BVRIT Hyderabad, CGPA 8.80.
